description: Issues a KMS-attested Statutory Closing Safe-Harbor Certificate combining OFAC SDN Jaro-Winkler/LEI Merkle proof screening, multi-factor hedonic collateral fair-value attestation, and HUD-1 Line 1109 pass-through fee calculation ($95 flat or 10 bps on escrow notional). Use when: an escrow agent, title company, aviation/maritime closing attorney, or autonomous clearing agent requires a signed compliance and fair-value certificate prior to wire disbursement. Do not use when: you only need a standalone counterparty name check without collateral valuation or HUD-1 closing fee calculation (use screen_ofac_entity instead). Behavior: Read-only, deterministic, idempotent compliance and valuation oracle with zero external side effects.

asset_class.description: Collateral asset class for hedonic fair-value and LTV calibration.

asset_identifier.description: Tail number, IMO vessel number, parcel ID, or CUSIP.

buyer_entity.description: Legal name of the buyer or escrow agent.

counterparty_entity.description: Legal name of the seller or counterparty entity to screen against OFAC SDN.

name: issue_safe_harbor_certificate

buyer_entity.description: Buyer or escrow agent entity name.

collateral_valuation.description: Hedonic fair-value and recommended LTV bounds.

ofac_screening.description: OFAC SDN screening status and SHA-256 Merkle proof.
